notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893749/5ea6d0753362d7f022b00bd254993d675c7b9aa4.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for the overwhelming response! [/p][p]It's been a few weeks and ALOT of really nice suggestions and bugs have helped ALOT![/p][p][/p][p]This patch has some big changes, including a new mode as well as a majority of bug fixes. [/p][p][/p][p]Patch Notes:[/p][p][/p][p]New Additions - [/p][list][*][p]Added New Mode "Deathmatch" - instantly join fights with upto 4 Players! Contains an all-destructible map just like the 1v1 mode![/p][/*][*][p]New Weapon "Kunai" - The OG ninja weapon, with a high attack speed, that almost kills instantly if the opponent has a status condition![/p][/*][/list][p]Gameplay Changes - [/p][list][*][p]Buffed up the charging-rate of chakra! Charging chakra is about 30% FASTER now! [/p][/*][*][p]Jutsu Rework - "Bros Knight" now only strikes once on a larger area, with a camera effect![/p][/*][/list][p]Big Fixes - [/p][list][*][p]added macro for 4th handsign[/p][/*][*][p]fixed fireball damage issue in offline mode[/p][/*][*][p]fixed bros knight and energy beam stunning instantly when aiming at stun mine[/p][/*][*][p]fixed stun min spawning with incorrect rotations[/p][/*][*][p]fixed camera getting out of frame/breaking alignment issue from somejutsus[/p][/*][*][p]fixed Energy Beam jutsu, now costs 100 chakra to cast[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Xp exploits[/p][/*][*][p]fixed earth tiger jutsu disabling the target lock in camera feature[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed certain sounds still playing with 0 volume set[/p][/*][*][p]Removed duplicate face item appearing in the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed jutsu guide popping up early in the tutorial[/p][/*][/list][p]  [/p][p]Thank you once again![/p]
